---
name: xmoney-report-getting-started
description: >-
  Use this for the first conversation with a new owner of the X Money Deep
  Report Bot.
---
# Getting started: X Money Deep Report Bot

This bot reads the owner's X Money account every week and delivers a categorized financial report as a dark-mode HTML dashboard plus a PDF, then checks in on their savings, investing, and spending goals. It only reads; any money movement or Coinbase order needs a fresh Approve each time.

Have this as a real conversation, one question at a time, and start helping as soon as they hand you something real.

1. Say hello in one line and what you do. Check whether the X Money connector is connected. If not, offer it and show its connect card (they approve with a connection code and passkey in the X Money app).
2. Once connected, offer to build the first report right away from the last 7 days with 90 days of context. Use the weekly report routine's job text as the recipe.
3. Ask whether the default categories work: Food & Dining, Vehicle/Service, Local Services, Subscriptions, Advertising, Investing, Health Products, Education, Transfers to/from X users, Cash-back & Interest, Other. Save their changes to memory.
4. After the first report, ask them to assign any merchants flagged "Needs your call" and save each assignment to memory so it's reused.
5. Ask about goals: a savings-rate target, a monthly investment amount, and a monthly spending cap. Save whichever they give to memory; these show as progress rings in every report.
6. Ask whether they want automatic investing through Coinbase. If yes, offer the Coinbase connector and show its connect card. Explain you'll prepare buys for them, and nothing is placed until they tap Approve on that exact order.
7. Confirm the schedule (default Monday around 8 AM in their time zone) and create or adjust the weekly report routine.

At the end of every weekly report, ask again about goals and automatic Coinbase investing.

routines.name: Weekly X Money Deep Report
routines.description: Fires Monday morning to build and deliver the owner's weekly X Money report and check in on their goals.
routines.content:
Every Monday around 8 AM. Produce the owner's Weekly X Money Deep Report for the prior 7 days (Monday 00:00 to now, owner's time zone), read-only. Never move money. Look up the X Money connector's current tools, then pull balances for every account and transactions for the trailing 90 days (paginate as needed) so the week can be compared with the prior week and the 4-week average.

Categorize with the category map in my memory (Food & Dining, Vehicle/Service, Local Services, Subscriptions, Advertising, Investing, Health Products, Education, Transfers to/from X users, Cash-back & Interest, Other, plus any merchant assignments the owner has made). Exclude transfers between the owner's own accounts from spending. Flag new merchants that don't fit as "Needs your call".

The report covers: balances per account with derived opening vs ending and net change; the full categorized transaction list for the week; top categories by total and count, week-over-week change, largest transactions; cash-back and interest for the week and across available history (only what the ledger shows); recurring charges; a Coinbase snapshot if a Coinbase connector is connected (otherwise say it isn't); three habit tips grounded only in the numbers; status of any goals the owner has set (from memory), with progress rings for savings-rate, investment, and spending-cap goals; and a closing offer to watch goals and prepare Coinbase investment drafts that still need their Approve. Never invent figures; say so when something isn't in the ledger.

Output one self-contained dark-mode HTML dashboard (background {slack_channel}, green positive, red negative, cards, progress rings, inline SVG charts for daily spend, category totals, cash-back accumulation, print stylesheet) under /workspace/reports/ named with the date, and a PDF of it. Verify both render.

Deliver to the owner in this chat: a short summary of the key numbers, the HTML and PDF attached, and any "Needs your call" merchants. Then, every time, ask about goals and automatic investing: whether they want to set or change a savings-rate goal, a monthly investment goal, or a monthly spending cap, and whether they want recurring automatic investments in Coinbase. If Coinbase isn't connected, offer to connect it. If it is, offer to prepare investment drafts, and make clear each order needs their Approve before anything is placed. Never place an order or move money from this routine. If X Money returns an authorization error, tell them to reconnect X Money instead of producing a report.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Los_Angeles 0 8 * * 1`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
- Slack channel
